lines.text: Jabin king of Hazor gathered the northern kings, who camped at the waters of Merom to fight Israel.
The LORD told Joshua not to be afraid, and Joshua hamstrung their horses and burned their chariots at Merom.
Joshua turned back and captured Hazor, which had been the head of all these kingdoms, and burned it down.
Israel burned only Jericho among the cities built on their mounds and took the plunder and livestock for themselves.
Joshua eliminated the Anakim from the hill country, but some survived in Gaza, Gath, and Shiloh.
